open_points.subject: assign_staff_project
open_points.text: assign_staff_project: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_staff of the staff_access repository of that transaction, a StaffAccessRepository, and through its get_staff_assignment and its insert_staff_assignment.
open_points.other_text: assign_staff_project: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST complete both its authorization check and its Registry validation before it opens a transaction, never while one is open, because the authorization check opens a transaction of its own and a second one nested inside this transaction is forbidden, and because a transaction must never stay open across a call to an external service. It MUST then open its transaction with an explicit assignment, never as a context manager, reach account and assignment persistence only through the staff_access repository of that transaction, append its audit only with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, use no legacy transaction-level staff method, and close the transaction exactly once.
open_points.question: Must every read and write use only the three StaffAccessRepository operations, or must the audit write use append_audit through the transaction's audit repository?

open_points.subject: authenticate_staff
open_points.text: authenticate_staff: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_staff_by_email and insert_staff_session of the staff_access repository of that transaction, a StaffAccessRepository.
open_points.other_text: authenticate_staff: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST append, with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, exactly one audit on every outcome and commit it before it returns or raises, its intent built with the imported build_staff_login_audit_intent: passing the STAFF_LOGIN member of = models.AuditAction with the SUCCESS member of = models.AuditResult when a session was issued, and its STAFF_LOGIN_FAILED member with the REJECTED member of = models.AuditResult on every rejection, including an unknown email, a non-active account and a wrong password. As actor_id it MUST pass the staff_id of the persisted account and as entity_id the canonical string of that identifier, and None for both when no account matched the normalized email. The concealed rejection is raised only after that commit, so the record survives the failure.
open_points.question: Must every write use insert_staff_session through StaffAccessRepository, or must the required audit write use append_audit through AuditRepository?

open_points.subject: change_staff_status
open_points.text: change_staff_status: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_staff of the staff_access repository of that transaction, a StaffAccessRepository, and through its list_staff_sessions, its update_staff_account and its update_staff_sessions.
open_points.other_text: change_staff_status: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST complete its authorization check before it opens a transaction, never while one is open, because that check opens a transaction of its own and a second one nested inside this transaction is forbidden. It MUST then open its transaction with an explicit assignment, never as a context manager, reach account and session persistence only through the staff_access repository of that transaction, append its audit only with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, use no legacy transaction-level staff method, and close the transaction exactly once.
open_points.question: Must every write use only the listed StaffAccessRepository operations, or must the audit write use append_audit through the transaction's audit repository?

open_points.subject: create_staff_account
open_points.text: create_staff_account: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_staff_by_email and insert_staff_account of the staff_access repository of that transaction, a StaffAccessRepository.
open_points.other_text: create_staff_account: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append exactly one audit, its intent built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent passing as action the STAFF_CREATE member of = models.AuditAction, as entity_kind the STAFF_ACCOUNT member of = models.AuditEntityKind, as entity_id the staff_id of the new account and as project_id None, in the same transaction that inserts the account, before that transaction commits. Committing the account without that audit is forbidden.
open_points.question: Must every write use get_staff_by_email or insert_staff_account through StaffAccessRepository, or must the required audit be written through append_audit and AuditRepository?

open_points.subject: perform_recovery_override
open_points.text: perform_recovery_override: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_staff and update_staff_account of the staff_access repository of that transaction, a StaffAccessRepository.
open_points.other_text: perform_recovery_override: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST be administrator-only, enforce R16 on replacement_email, append the enhanced audit of the STAFF_RECOVERY_OVERRIDE member of = models.AuditAction atomically with the replacement; it is the one operation that changes a login email. It MUST return the hash-free = models.StaffAccountView the imported build_staff_account_view builds from the replaced account, so password_hash never leaves this module.
open_points.question: Must every write use get_staff or update_staff_account through StaffAccessRepository, or must the operation also write its required audit through the audit repository?

open_points.subject: revoke_staff_project_assignment
open_points.text: revoke_staff_project_assignment: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_staff_assignment_by_id and update_staff_assignment of the staff_access repository of that transaction, a StaffAccessRepository.
open_points.other_text: revoke_staff_project_assignment: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST complete its authorization check before it opens a transaction, never while one is open, because that check opens a transaction of its own and a second one nested inside this transaction is forbidden. It MUST then open its transaction with an explicit assignment, never as a context manager, reach assignment persistence only through the staff_access repository of that transaction, append its audit only with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, use no legacy transaction-level staff method, and close the transaction exactly once.
open_points.question: Must every write use only the two StaffAccessRepository operations, or must the audit write use append_audit through the transaction's audit repository?

open_points.other_text: revoke_staff_sessions: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST complete its authorization check before it opens a transaction, never while one is open, because that check opens a transaction of its own and a second one nested inside this transaction is forbidden. It MUST then open its transaction with an explicit assignment, never as a context manager, reach session persistence only through the staff_access repository of that transaction, append its audit only with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, use no legacy transaction-level staff method, and close the transaction exactly once.
open_points.question: Must every write use list_staff_sessions or update_staff_sessions through StaffAccessRepository, or must the audit write use append_audit through the transaction's audit repository?

open_points.subject: sign_out_staff
open_points.text: sign_out_staff: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_staff_session of the staff_access repository of that transaction, a StaffAccessRepository, and through its update_staff_sessions and its get_staff.
open_points.other_text: sign_out_staff: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open its transaction with an explicit assignment, never as a context manager, reach session persistence only through the staff_access repository of that transaction, append its audit only with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, use no legacy transaction-level staff method, and close the transaction exactly once: the revocation commits once, and a failure rolls back with the rollback of that transaction only while the local open flag still marks the transaction open and re-raises the original failure unchanged.
